fx_usd_inr.source: Vendor V2's own stated reference rate, quote page 1
fx_usd_inr.alternative: RBI reference rate on bid-due date
fx_usd_inr.note: V2's terms say conversion happens at the rate on the INVOICE date, not the bid date. Any INR total for V2 is therefore an estimate, not an offer. The buyer sees this wherever a V2 total is shown.
fx_usd_inr.confidence: stated by vendor, not independently verified

compare_qty.note: Where a vendor quoted a different quantity (V1 MOQ 20 boxes, V3 128 docks), the unit rate is applied to the ASKED quantity so lines stay comparable. The quantity difference is carried as a separate flag, not silently absorbed.

v2_warranty_basis.source: V2 quote note on lines 1-3 plus vendor-created line 30A
v2_warranty_basis.alternative: exclude 30A and compare 1-year cover against 3-year cover
v2_warranty_basis.note: V2's laptops carry 1-year cover. Every other bid carries 3-year. Comparing them without the uplift understates V2 by Rs 7,900 per laptop.

v2_footnote_discount.note: Conditional on a deal-registration approval V2 does not hold yet. Shown to the buyer as a named upside scenario, never folded into the headline number.

v4_early_po_discount.source: V4 rate card, handwritten and circled
v4_early_po_discount.note: Conditional on a PO by 25 Sep, which is before the internal approval cycle can close. Treated as unavailable rather than as a price.

v1_total_discount.note: 2.5% on order value, not attributable to any line. It cannot be used in per-line ranking. It is applied only to a whole-of-V1 award total, and the system says so wherever the two disagree.

tax_basis.note: V3 said 'taxes as applicable' and V4 wrote '+ GST' with no rate. Both are READ AS ex-GST. That is an assumption, not a finding, and it is flagged on both vendors.
tax_basis.confidence: assumed - vendor did not state a rate

freight_duty.source: RFx asked FOR destination; V2 quoted ex-works Singapore
freight_duty.note: V2's imported lines exclude customs duty and freight, which the buyer bears. No duty rate is assumed. V2's datacentre lines are therefore NOT directly comparable and are marked as such rather than silently ranked.
